meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范编写并检查关键帧动画代码(支持 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js、3D 等)。它先确认动画对象、状态与时长,再选最小实现机制,最后用 hyperframes 命令验证并修正。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧等动画能力,或需要 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发。不用于场景整体规划、品牌设计或字幕等。

say.text: 用 CSS 关键帧给标题做一个淡入加轻微上移,保持可跳转。
运行 hyperframes keyframes 检查这个场景,并修复报错。
say.note: Claude 会执行诊断并修正关键帧。

howto.what_en: Claude authors and checks keyframe animation code per HyperFrames specs (GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, 3D). It identifies subject, states, duration, picks the minimal mechanism, then verifies and fixes via hyperframes CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP, CSS, etc., or 'hyperframes keyframes' diagnostics. Not for broad scene strategy, brand design, captions, or general video planning.

say_en.text: Create a GSAP timeline for HyperFrames: progress bar moves left to right in 2s.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and register the timeline.

say_en.text: Fade in the title with CSS keyframes and a slight upward move, seek-safe.
say_en.note: Uses fill-mode: both and other rules.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes on this scene and fix any errors.
say_en.note: Claude will run diagnostics and fix keyframes.
